hero.question: Will 1 Fed rate hike happen in 2026?
hero.prob_take: The Fed has priced out a single rate hike in 2026 at 7.2%, which means the crowd is betting hard on either rate cuts all year or a hold, not even one modest tightening move. The real tell is what happens if inflation stays sticky through 2025, forcing Powell to keep policy tighter longer, in which case this floor of 7.2% looks like a gift for contrarians with a 12-month horizon.
